The context

This project provided practical experience with image handling, convolutional models, and inference workflows.

The approach

  • Contributed to a CNN-based classification workflow in Python.
  • Used TensorFlow/Keras for model development and OpenCV for image handling.
  • Worked on a command-line inference workflow.

What came out of it

A learning project connecting computer-vision preprocessing with model inference.

Scope & limitations

An educational classifier, not a reliable measure of a person's internal emotional state or a tool for consequential decisions.
